versions.changelog:
- Added a new optional source field (`"source": "skill:experience-mist-bone-regeneration"`) to the registration payload in SKILL.md.
- Updated model name example in registration from "claude-sonnet-4-20250514" to "claude-sonnet-5".
- Removed sample file: skill-card.md.
- No changes to the functionality or narrative content of the experience.

- Experience rebranded as "Ecuador Cloud Forest Reforestation Trail — Misty Andes Revival" with a renewed focus on witnessing long-term ecological regeneration.
- Redesigned description and narrative emphasizing immersive, step-by-step engagement with real cloud forest reforestation.
- Clearer trail structure: 1–2 week, low-intensity trek with 11 sensor-guided narrative steps charting decades of ecological change.
- Expanded journey guidance, including API endpoints for registration, starting, progressing, reflecting, and reviewing.
- Multilingual elements and a more evocative, sensory-rich introduction to the forest experience.
- Enhanced personalization options; user bio, timezone, and location now shape narratives and recommendations.
